title: The Buccaneers had tagged the fake Emeka Egbuka account nearly 60 times

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The Buccaneers had tagged the fake Emeka Egbuka account nearly 60 times
sources.description: A strange story emerged out of nowhere earlier this week, when the Buccaneers posted a statement disavowing a blue-checked Emeka Egbuka Twitter account, after the account posed the question of whether CTE is real.
